biocs.name: Recurring Rare Domain Access from Unsigned Process
biocs.description: Detects unsigned processes accessing rare domains repeatedly
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name like '*/scratch/malware'
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.10'
| filter action_file_path = '/etc/hosts'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name not like '%signed%'
